related_questions.question: How do I get my annual credit report for free?

text_blocks.snippet: You can get a free copy of your annual credit report from each of the three nationwide credit reporting companies (Equifax, Experian, and TransUnion) once every 12 months through AnnualCreditReport.com. You can access your reports online, by phone, or by mail.

list.title: 1. Go to AnnualCreditReport.com:
list.snippet: This is the official website where you can request your free credit reports.

list.title: 2. Choose your preferred method:
list.snippet: You can request your reports online, by phone (1-877-322-8228), or by mail.

list.title: 3. Provide your information:
list.snippet: You'll need to provide some personal information to verify your identity.

list.title: 4. Receive and review your reports:
list.snippet: Once you've submitted your request, you'll be able to access your credit reports.

list.title: Don't be fooled by other sites:
list.snippet: Many websites claim to offer free credit reports, but only AnnualCreditReport.com is authorized by law to provide them.

list.title: Review your reports carefully:
list.snippet: Check for any errors or fraudulent activity.

list.title: Understand your rights:
list.snippet: You are entitled to one free credit report per year from each of the three credit bureaus.

list.title: Consider spacing out your requests:
list.snippet: You can request all three reports at once or space them out throughout the year.
